IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, windswept
dark brown hair stands beside a dark car in cool
daylight. She wears a full-length red wool wrap coat
with a stand collar, a row of gold buttons at the
shoulder, and a self-tie belt. She holds a black
leather top-handle bag with gold hardware and
wears black gloves. Her expression is serious, and
her gaze is steady. Crisp, natural light, a rich
palette of crimson, charcoal, and gold. Confident
and polished, in the style of a winter fashion
editorial.
